texts.fd_email_throwaway: Leli kheli le-imeyili lihlala isikhashana nje. Sebenzisa ikheli ozoligcina.

texts.fd_match_retry: Cela inombolo entsha kwenye idivayisi, bese uzama futhi.
texts.fd_our_side: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle ohlangothini lwethu. Akulona iphutha lakho.
texts.fd_owner_plan: Umnikazi angakhetha uhlelo olukhulu ku-Izinhlelo nemikhawulo.
texts.fd_ref: Inombolo yereferensi {ref}. Yisho uma uxhumana nosizo.
texts.fd_short: Le nombolo imfushane kakhulu. Izinombolo zase-{country} zinamadijithi angu-{n}.
texts.fd_use_code: Vula isixhumanisi noma ubhale ikhodi esesimemweni sakho.
texts.fd_use_ticket: Sebenzisa ithikithi osunalo, noma uqale ushiye lowo mugqa.
